<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Rushing Boar](/Feats.aspx?ID=5498) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Emotion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=590" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=647" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 78

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486); wereboar

**Trigger**
An attack from a creature that isn’t adjacent to you damaged you.

**Requirements**
You’re in boar or hybrid shape.

</column>

---

You embrace the pain of the triggering attack, allowing it to drive you into a violent rush. You Stride in a straight line toward the triggering creature.
name: Rushing Boar
requirement: You’re in boar or hybrid shape.
